title: HF3185 (2023-2024 Regular): Immunity granted to private parties who require proof of firearms eligibility prior to transferring a firearm.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-03-31; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/3185/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (2023-03-31); no vote listed. Added words are not marked in the saved text; paragraph (b) is quoted as the new passage per the title. Paragraph (a), the gross misdemeanor for transfers without the section 624.7132 check, is existing law.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1f, para. (b)): A person is immune from prosecution under paragraph (a) if the person produces either a copy of the transferee's permit to carry or permit to purchase that the transferee presented at the time of transfer. A transferor may only be required to produce documents maintained pursuant to this paragraph if a court orders production of the documents as part of a criminal investigation involving the transferred firearm. A court may not compel a transferor to produce documents maintained pursuant to this paragraph beyond one year after the date of transfer.
